records.title: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM OUTER RING ROAD
details:
(a), (b) & (f) For development of Greenfield National Highway between Vizhinjam and 
Navaikkulam Outer Ring Road Project (Thiruvananthapuram Outer Ring Road), the revised 
Detailed Project Report (DPR) has been prepared. Based upon the experience in implementing 
the project augmentation for National Highway 66 (NH 66), the DPR was reviewed to minimise 
hill cutting with provisions of tunnels & Viaducts. The decision on investment shall be taken 
considering fulfilment of criterion, traffic density and synergy with PM Gati Shakti. However, various statutory clearances 
especially environmental clearances are being obtained.

records.title: Structural collapses at airports
details:
This Ministry has constituted a High Level Expert Committee consisting of Structural Engineers from
IIT Delhi to assess the incident at Delhi T1 and submit its report. Further, all the Airport Operators have
been directed to carry out a Third Party Audit of structural stability of airport buildings and associated
infrastructures through a reputed Government Institution/Body such as IITs, NITs, CBRI, EIL etc. It has also been decided to carry out Third Party structural audit by reputed agencies like IIT/NIT/Govt.
Engineering Colleges, EIL etc.
